description: This Java class 'PreviewTileLayout' implements a layout algorithm for rendering previews in a tiled grid within the Android Studio rendering system. It manages layout calculations, grid computation, and positioning of preview elements for XML layout previews.

classes.name: PreviewTileLayout
classes.description: A layout manager for arranging RenderPreview objects in a tiled grid for rendering previews in Android Studio.

methods.name: performLayout
methods.description: Calculates and assigns positions and sizes to the preview elements based on available space.

methods.name: layoutRows
methods.description: Arranges the preview elements row by row, adjusting positions and sizes for alignment.

methods.name: layoutRow
methods.description: Positions individual previews within a row, centering or aligning as needed.

methods.name: computeGrid
methods.description: Creates a 2D array grid of RenderPreview objects based on the aspect ratio and fill strategy.

methods.name: pickAspectRatio
methods.description: Determines a representative aspect ratio for the set of previews.

methods.name: computeOptimalShape
methods.description: Calculates the best number of rows and columns to fit all previews within available space.

methods.name: getFixedRenderSize
methods.description: Returns the fixed size for rendering if set.

methods.name: getLayoutHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height used by the layout after performLayout.
